sector_1_1.speaker: darius
sector_1_1.text: Sunlight's fading fast. The trench mouth opens ahead.

sector_1_2.speaker: lyra
sector_1_2.text: Daddy, the reef is lighting up... it's calling for defenders.

sector_1_3.speaker: naya
sector_1_3.text: Old Terran wreckage detected. Useful alloys for the quantum fabricator.

sector_1_4.speaker: darius
sector_1_4.text: Hold on to your thrusters. The bottom just dropped out.

sector_1_5.speaker: thorne
sector_1_5.text: That sensor buoy is pinging our location. Blast it before it calls the fleet.

sector_1_6.speaker: naya
sector_1_6.text: These ancient stone channels were built to nurture prototypes.

sector_1_7.speaker: lyra
sector_1_7.text: The green light is dancing across the cockpit. I can hear distant humming.

sector_1_8.speaker: darius
sector_1_8.text: Thermal chimneys blowing black smoke! Watch your temperature gauges.

sector_1_9.speaker: naya
sector_1_9.text: Fortress gate perimeter sighted. Heavy defensive resistance inbound.

sector_1_10.speaker: darius
sector_1_10.text: Guardian signature confirmed on radar. Time to earn our passage.

sector_2_1.speaker: darius
sector_2_1.text: Bleached coral as far as the eye can see. Pure silence.

sector_2_2.speaker: naya
sector_2_2.text: Flying between ancient rib arches. Sensors picking up residual marrow radiation.

sector_2_3.speaker: cross
sector_2_3.text: I recognize those hull numbers. Old Navy brothers trapped in the reef.

sector_2_4.speaker: lyra
sector_2_4.text: The purple flowers... they're trying to put my mind to sleep, Daddy.

sector_2_5.speaker: darius
sector_2_5.text: I hear music from home. Stay sharp, it's just crystal resonance.

sector_2_6.speaker: thorne
sector_2_6.text: Stone amphitheater ahead. Prepare for an ambush in the center ring.

sector_2_7.speaker: naya
sector_2_7.text: Prismatic glare is splitting our HUD crosshairs. Fire on physical telemetry.

sector_2_8.speaker: darius
sector_2_8.text: Scrap signals lighting up the board. Harvest what we can on the fly.

sector_2_9.speaker: lyra
sector_2_9.text: The vault doors are opening, Daddy... they're crying out for release.

sector_2_10.speaker: darius
sector_2_10.text: Vault Golem is assembling! Break its crystal armor before it fires!

sector_3_1.speaker: darius
sector_3_1.text: Europa's sub-glacial ocean. The cradle of the Coelacanths.

sector_3_2.speaker: thorne
sector_3_2.text: Geysers blowing from the ice floor! Keep your elevation high!

sector_3_3.speaker: naya
sector_3_3.text: Unfinished Coelacanth prototypes detected. They're drawn to our engines.

sector_3_4.speaker: darius
sector_3_4.text: Ride the warm updrafts from the fissure. It'll restore engine efficiency.

sector_3_5.speaker: lyra
sector_3_5.text: The incubator eggs are pulsing in rhythm with my heartbeat...

sector_3_6.speaker: thorne
sector_3_6.text: Ice ceiling is coming down! Throttle up and clear the corridor!

sector_3_7.speaker: naya
sector_3_7.text: This was Ophion's graveyard before he found Haven-7. A heavy price was paid.

sector_3_8.speaker: cross
sector_3_8.text: Navy survey team was wiped here in '62. The sentry turrets are still hot.

sector_3_9.speaker: lyra
sector_3_9.text: The Queen knows we're outside, Daddy. She's humming a lullaby.

sector_3_10.speaker: darius
sector_3_10.text: Queen Coelacanth has surfaced! Focus all heat ordnance on her core!

sector_4_1.speaker: darius
sector_4_1.text: The Veil Nebula. The stars look like they're melting into water.

sector_4_2.speaker: naya
sector_4_2.text: Sensors showing three targets for every drone. Shoot the one with engine wake.

sector_4_3.speaker: thorne
sector_4_3.text: Stardust is scraping the paint clean off my armor. Watch your speed.

sector_4_4.speaker: lyra
sector_4_4.text: The nebula wants to tell us a story, Daddy. It's about a world made of glass.

sector_4_5.speaker: darius
sector_4_5.text: Plasma squall ahead! Dive into the magnetic channel to stay stable.

sector_4_6.speaker: naya
sector_4_6.text: Protostar flare warning! Shield deflectors to 100%.

sector_4_7.speaker: thorne
sector_4_7.text: I'm hearing my own callout on the radio before I say it. Disorienting.

sector_4_8.speaker: cross
sector_4_8.text: My old flight academy training cruiser is drifting in that cloud. Eerie.

sector_4_9.speaker: lyra
sector_4_9.text: We're almost at the heart of the dream. Don't let go of what is real, Daddy.

sector_4_10.speaker: darius
sector_4_10.text: The Dreamer Golem is manifesting! Fire across its anchor points!

sector_5_1.speaker: darius
sector_5_1.text: Saturn's rings. Trillions of tons of frozen shrapnel spinning at orbital speed.

sector_5_2.speaker: cross
sector_5_2.text: My former squadron is lurking in the ice shadows. Watch your six.

sector_5_3.speaker: thorne
sector_5_3.text: Heavy railgun batteries mounted on the icebergs. Knock out their power generators.

sector_5_4.speaker: naya
sector_5_4.text: Nitrogen geysers venting across our flight path. Bank left to clear the vapor.

sector_5_5.speaker: darius
sector_5_5.text: Lasers diffusing in the diamond dust! Switch to kinetic rockets!

sector_5_6.speaker: darius
sector_5_6.text: Dozens of Navy destroyers smashed together like frozen scrap cars.

sector_5_7.speaker: thorne
sector_5_7.text: Comms are jammed with military noise! Switch to Haven-7 direct laser link!

sector_5_8.speaker: naya
sector_5_8.text: Entering the dark side of the ring. Hull heaters on standby.

sector_5_9.speaker: cross
sector_5_9.text: Kraken Fortress sighted. This was Crane's master weapon. Time to tear it apart.

sector_5_10.speaker: darius
sector_5_10.text: Kraken is opening all torpedo tubes! Evade the volley and hit the bridge!

sector_6_1.speaker: darius
sector_6_1.text: Fire nebula. Everything out here has been cooked to molten slag.

sector_6_2.speaker: naya
sector_6_2.text: Magma plumes arcing across the sector like burning bridges. Fly under the arc.

sector_6_3.speaker: thorne
sector_6_3.text: Smelter drones are harvesting the asteroid belt. Break up their convoy.

sector_6_4.speaker: darius
sector_6_4.text: Solar flare incoming! Tuck behind that iron asteroid for cover!

sector_6_5.speaker: lyra
sector_6_5.text: The glass is glowing red in the dark... it looks like burning veins.

sector_6_6.speaker: naya
sector_6_6.text: Crucible vats ahead. If they rupture, the whole corridor will be flooded with slag.

sector_6_7.speaker: thorne
sector_6_7.text: Pace your shots, Darius! The ambient heat is redlining our weapon radiators.

sector_6_8.speaker: darius
sector_6_8.text: I see the power conduits. Blow the cooling lines to force an emergency shutdown.

sector_6_9.speaker: cross
sector_6_9.text: The main foundry gates are opening. Automated guardians are rolling out.

sector_6_10.speaker: darius
sector_6_10.text: Forge-Mind is engaging! Strike the crucible coolers and shatter its frame!

sector_7_1.speaker: darius
sector_7_1.text: Jupiter's Storm Belt. Five thousand mile-an-hour gale winds slamming into the hull.

sector_7_2.speaker: naya
sector_7_2.text: Static building on the cockpit canopy. Disperse shields before the lightning strikes!

sector_7_3.speaker: thorne
sector_7_3.text: Predator drones diving out of the storm clouds! Flak burst on my mark!

sector_7_4.speaker: lyra
sector_7_4.text: The lightning is so bright... but behind it, I can hear a voice singing.

sector_7_5.speaker: darius
sector_7_5.text: Downdraft pulling us down! Boost engines to escape the atmospheric sink!

sector_7_6.speaker: naya
sector_7_6.text: Hull groaning under atmospheric pressure. We need to reach the eye of the storm.

sector_7_7.speaker: thorne
sector_7_7.text: Ball lightning drifting toward our engines! Cut power for two seconds to break lock!

sector_7_8.speaker: darius
sector_7_8.text: Punching through the eye wall! Hold the flight stick with both hands!

sector_7_9.speaker: lyra
sector_7_9.text: We made it to the quiet center. The Storm-Singer is right in front of us.

sector_7_10.speaker: darius
sector_7_10.text: Storm-Singer is charging its lightning vortex! Evade the funnel and attack the core!

sector_8_1.speaker: darius
sector_8_1.text: The ghost fleet. Hundreds of battleships floating dead in the black.

sector_8_2.speaker: cross
sector_8_2.text: Those point-defense turrets are still hunting on Admiral Crane's orders.

sector_8_3.speaker: thorne
sector_8_3.text: Boarding pods launching from the carrier wrecks! Shoot them down before they attach!

sector_8_4.speaker: naya
sector_8_4.text: Radiation spiking in sector four. Keep distance from the cracked reactor cores.

sector_8_5.speaker: darius
sector_8_5.text: Weaving through shattered battlecruiser hulls. Watch the protruding superstructure.

sector_8_6.speaker: cross
sector_8_6.text: Heavy automated dreadnought on patrol. It hasn't received a stand-down order in 30 years.

sector_8_7.speaker: thorne
sector_8_7.text: Don't trust the radar blips. Verify targets through the optical scope.

sector_8_8.speaker: naya
sector_8_8.text: Synchronized particle lance batteries sighted. We need to disable the relay ships.

sector_8_9.speaker: darius
sector_8_9.text: Flagship Goliath dead ahead. Crane's automated ghost is waiting on the bridge.

sector_8_10.speaker: darius
sector_8_10.text: Goliath main batteries powering up! Break its shield generator arrays!

sector_9_1.speaker: darius
sector_9_1.text: The Xenomorph Hive. The planet itself is breathing and watching us.

sector_9_2.speaker: naya
sector_9_2.text: Acid spitters firing from the bio-towers! Dodge laterally to avoid the splash!

sector_9_3.speaker: thorne
sector_9_3.text: Chitin walls are closing the tunnel! Blast a hole through the membrane!

sector_9_4.speaker: lyra
sector_9_4.text: Daddy... the walls are whispering in Mom's voice. Don't listen to them!

sector_9_5.speaker: naya
sector_9_5.text: Nursery sector. Wipe out the egg clusters before they hatch into interceptors.

sector_9_6.speaker: darius
sector_9_6.text: Bio-acid dripping from the ceiling. Keep flight trim tight and centered.

sector_9_7.speaker: thorne
sector_9_7.text: Destroy the neural bridge nodes. It'll blind their defensive coordination.

sector_9_8.speaker: naya
sector_9_8.text: Chitin Brute charging down the corridor! Aim for the soft joints under its carapace!

sector_9_9.speaker: lyra
sector_9_9.text: She's waiting for us in the center of the web. Her thoughts are overwhelming.

sector_9_10.speaker: darius
sector_9_10.text: Hive Mother has uncoiled! Sever her neural tentacles and break her crown!

sector_10_1.speaker: darius
sector_10_1.text: The Core Rift. The edge of reality itself. We made it, Lyra.

sector_10_2.speaker: naya
sector_10_2.text: Enemies are rewinding their attack vectors! Anticipate the temporal loop!

sector_10_3.speaker: lyra
sector_10_3.text: I can read the code in the dark, Daddy. It says... everything is connected.

sector_10_4.speaker: thorne
sector_10_4.text: Null-space rifts opening ahead! Steer clear of the black voids!

sector_10_5.speaker: naya
sector_10_5.text: Paradox fighters are phased across timelines. Hit them when they fully materialize.

sector_10_6.speaker: darius
sector_10_6.text: I see ships from every timeline flying alongside us. We're not alone.

sector_10_7.speaker: thorne
sector_10_7.text: Engines at 110%! Keep forward velocity or get pulled into the core!

sector_10_8.speaker: lyra
sector_10_8.text: The spires are singing the first song of creation. We're almost at the throne.

sector_10_9.speaker: architect
sector_10_9.text: You who travel through time and sorrow... approach the final threshold...

sector_10_10.speaker: darius
sector_10_10.text: The Cyber Coelacanth has awakened! All weapons, all hearts, full burn!

banter_b1_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_level_start_tier1_0.text: Deepest place on Earth. Grandpa made it here forty years ago.

banter_b1_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: naya
banter_b1_level_start_tier1_1.text: The water pressure would crush conventional alloys. The Nyxa is not conventional.

banter_b1_level_start_tier1_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b1_level_start_tier1_2.text: Daddy, I can feel something down there. It's old. It's been waiting.

banter_b1_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_level_start_tier2_0.text: Watch the silt vents this time! That last ambush took our shields down fast.

banter_b1_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b1_level_start_tier2_1.text: Sensors recalibrated. Acoustic sentinels cluster on the left ridge—flank them early.

banter_b1_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b1_level_start_tier2_2.text: Daddy, I can read their pulse rhythm now. Shoot when the biolight flashes green!

banter_b1_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_level_start_tier3_0.text: Third dive into the silt. We know their patrol loops now. Clear them out.

banter_b1_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: thorne
banter_b1_level_start_tier3_1.text: No hesitation, Darius. Full burn through the trench choke point.

banter_b1_level_start_tier3_2.speaker: naya
banter_b1_level_start_tier3_2.text: We have the tactical advantage this run. Let's finish the sweep clean.

banter_b1_unique_enemy_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_unique_enemy_0.text: What IS that thing? Some kind of mechanical angler fish?

banter_b1_unique_enemy_1.speaker: naya
banter_b1_unique_enemy_1.text: A biosynthetic sentinel. The Coelacanth network spawns defenders.

banter_b1_unique_enemy_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b1_unique_enemy_2.text: Its lantern is broadcasting a jammer pulse! Don't look at the light!

banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: That's no wreckage. That's the Guardian. It's moving.

banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: Daddy... it knows you're here. It recognizes something in you.

banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Aim for the dorsal energy vents before it charges the main beam! Don't let it pin us.

banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Targeting arrays locked onto the lateral nodes. Break the shield generators first!

banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Keep your distance on the charge cycle, Darius! It sweeps the lower quadrant.

banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: We know every move it makes now. Tear down those hardpoints!

banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: It's weakening, Daddy! Strike the core while its rhythm stutters!

banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier3_2.speaker: naya
banter_b1_boss_entrance_tier3_2.text: Maximum firepower. This Leviathan goes down right now.

banter_b1_player_death_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_player_death_0.text: Not yet. I'm not done yet. Lyra's waiting.

banter_b1_player_death_1.speaker: naya
banter_b1_player_death_1.text: Darius, hull failure! Emergency nanites deploying!

banter_b1_player_death_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b1_player_death_2.text: Daddy! Hold on, I'm boosting the emergency beacon!

banter_b1_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Second try. The deep doesn't get to win that easily.

banter_b1_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Rerouted power from life support to forward deflectors. Let's counter them.

banter_b1_player_respawn_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b1_player_respawn_tier2_1.text: Nanite matrix restored. Angle your shields against the pressure wave.

banter_b1_player_respawn_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_player_respawn_tier3_0.text: Iron resolve. We're punching through this sector today.

banter_b1_player_respawn_tier3_1.speaker: thorne
banter_b1_player_respawn_tier3_1.text: Back in the fight, scrapper. Make every shot count.

banter_b1_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_low_health_0.text: Shields failing! I need some breathing room!

banter_b1_low_health_1.speaker: naya
banter_b1_low_health_1.text: Critical shield warning! Disengage from the crossfire!

banter_b1_wave_clear_1.speaker: naya
banter_b1_wave_clear_1.text: Path sanitized. Scanners picking up next wave.

banter_b1_wave_clear_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b1_wave_clear_2.text: Good shooting, Daddy! The way is open.

banter_b1_level_end_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_level_end_0.text: The Warden transmitted coordinates. He knew I'd come.

banter_b1_level_end_1.speaker: naya
banter_b1_level_end_1.text: Trench sector cleared. Descending to next depth horizon.

banter_b1_level_end_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b1_level_end_2.text: I can hear the reef singing ahead. We're getting closer.

banter_b1_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b1_pull_out_0.text: These anglerfish drones locked onto my heat signature! I'm pulling out!

banter_b1_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b1_pull_out_1.text: The dark in this trench is... heavy. It's trying to swallow my voice. I have to break contact!

banter_b1_pull_out_2.speaker: naya
banter_b1_pull_out_2.text: Cybernetic jellyfish swarm is overloading my shields! I'm pulling back to the reef edge!

banter_b1_pull_out_3.speaker: thorne
banter_b1_pull_out_3.text: Old sensors are blind in this silt. I'm backing out before I scrape the trench walls.

banter_b1_pull_out_4.speaker: selene
banter_b1_pull_out_4.text: Comms from Haven-7 are fracturing. The abyssal distortion is too thick, I'm dropping offline!

banter_b2_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_level_start_tier1_0.text: Coral graveyard. Whole reef, just dead. The Dreamer's been here.

banter_b2_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: naya
banter_b2_level_start_tier1_1.text: This was a thriving precursor colony. What happened here was deliberate.

banter_b2_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_level_start_tier2_0.text: Watch for the calcified spore mines. Clear them at distance before entering the archway.

banter_b2_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b2_level_start_tier2_1.text: Spore density is highest along the floor. Keep flight path elevated.

banter_b2_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b2_level_start_tier2_2.text: The ghost echoes are loud near the monoliths. I'm filtering the frequency.

banter_b2_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_level_start_tier3_0.text: We know the reef's layout now. Strike fast and don't linger in the spore clouds.

banter_b2_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: thorne
banter_b2_level_start_tier3_1.text: Sweep the calcified snipers before they anchor. Move!

banter_b2_level_start_tier3_2.speaker: naya
banter_b2_level_start_tier3_2.text: Precision flight protocol. The reef won't claim us this time.

banter_b2_unique_enemy_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_unique_enemy_0.text: Is that a GHOST? Coral formations don't just attack.

banter_b2_unique_enemy_1.speaker: naya
banter_b2_unique_enemy_1.text: Memory echoes. The reef remembers what killed it.

banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: The vault's defense system. Made of their deaths.

banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: naya
banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: Massive crystalline bio-construct. Resonance frequencies off the scale.

banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Shatter the outer crystal facets before it focuses the prismatic beam!

banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: thorne
banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Cross your fire across the central spire. Don't let it regenerate!

banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Daddy, the singing stops when the amber crystals break! Target those!

banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: Third round with the Vault Golem. Break its prism array and finish it.

banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: naya
banter_b2_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: Executing synchronized bombardment. Core exposure guaranteed.

banter_b2_player_death_1.speaker: naya
banter_b2_player_death_1.text: Darius is down! Activating emergency extraction!

banter_b2_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Second attempt. This reef deserves better than silence.

banter_b2_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Frequency dampers installed. The memory screams won't slow us down.

banter_b2_player_respawn_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b2_player_respawn_tier2_1.text: Sensors compensated for psychic refraction. Ready to engage.

banter_b2_player_respawn_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_player_respawn_tier3_0.text: We're making it through this graveyard. All guns blazing.

banter_b2_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_low_health_0.text: Hull integrity failing! These memories hit harder than torpedoes.

banter_b2_wave_clear_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_wave_clear_0.text: Wave clear. The reef is quiet for now.

banter_b2_wave_clear_1.speaker: naya
banter_b2_wave_clear_1.text: Memory constructs dispersed. Path forward identified.

banter_b2_level_end_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_level_end_0.text: The precursors chose extinction. What kind of courage is that?

banter_b2_level_end_1.speaker: naya
banter_b2_level_end_1.text: The kind that leaves echoes for ten thousand years.

banter_b2_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b2_pull_out_0.text: The memory vault defenses are firing phantom spikes! I'm pulling out before my hull crystallizes!

banter_b2_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b2_pull_out_1.text: So many old voices crying in this reef... it hurts! I have to shut them out!

banter_b2_pull_out_2.speaker: naya
banter_b2_pull_out_2.text: Ghost coral spores are clogging my engine intakes! I'm backing off to purge!

banter_b3_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_level_start_tier1_0.text: Europa. Beneath the ice. Where Coelacanths were born.

banter_b3_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: naya
banter_b3_level_start_tier1_1.text: The hatchery. I have complicated feelings about this place.

banter_b3_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_level_start_tier2_0.text: Sub-zero brine pools are freezing our thrusters. Use boost sparingly!

banter_b3_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: thorne
banter_b3_level_start_tier2_1.text: Cryo-mines ahead. Detonate them early with wide spread shot.

banter_b3_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b3_level_start_tier2_2.text: The baby bio-drones attack in triplets. Watch your six, Daddy!

banter_b3_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_level_start_tier3_0.text: We know the ice currents now. Full thrust through the nursery.

banter_b3_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: naya
banter_b3_level_start_tier3_1.text: Thermal cannons primed. Melting through their defensive perimeter.

banter_b3_unique_enemy_1.speaker: naya
banter_b3_unique_enemy_1.text: An embryonic prototype. The bio-fabricator is running corrupt templates.

banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: The Queen. She sees me as raw material for new young.

banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: Daddy... she's crying. She thinks she's protecting her nest.

banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Sever the egg sacs before she spawns the escort swarm!

banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Concentrate fire on the cryo-sacs. Disabling her freezing aura!

banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Roll out of her pounce trajectory! She hits the ceiling then dives!

banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: No more hesitation. Free the Queen from her corrupted loop.

banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: naya
banter_b3_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: Firing heavy armor-piercing salvo. The hatchery falls now.

banter_b3_player_death_1.speaker: naya
banter_b3_player_death_1.text: Darius, wake up! Don't let the frost claim you!

banter_b3_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Heating systems at maximum. Let's finish the dive.

banter_b3_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Hull de-icers active. Ready for their cryo-spread.

banter_b3_player_respawn_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b3_player_respawn_tier2_1.text: Shield modulation calibrated to thermal frequencies.

banter_b3_player_respawn_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_player_respawn_tier3_0.text: Unbreakable. Let's crack this ice shelf wide open.

banter_b3_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_low_health_0.text: Cryo-damage creeping into the cockpit! Life support failing!

banter_b3_wave_clear_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_wave_clear_0.text: Hatchery defenders cleared. Deeper into the sub-glacial trench.

banter_b3_level_end_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_level_end_0.text: Ophion really thought he could talk to the Dreamer.

banter_b3_level_end_1.speaker: naya
banter_b3_level_end_1.text: He was young. We all believed we could save everything back then.

banter_b3_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b3_pull_out_0.text: Freezing water is locking up my primary flight surfaces! Pulling back before I freeze solid!

banter_b3_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b3_pull_out_1.text: The Hatchery Queen... she thinks I'm one of her children! She's pulling my mind down! Help!

banter_b3_pull_out_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b3_pull_out_2.text: Ice shelf collapsing above us! I'm punching the thrusters to get clear!

banter_b4_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_level_start_tier1_0.text: The Veil Nebula. They say it's partially awake.

banter_b4_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b4_level_start_tier1_1.text: Daddy, I can hear it. Not words — feelings. It's so lonely.

banter_b4_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_level_start_tier2_0.text: Watch out for visual mirages! Sensors lag by two seconds in this plasma cloud.

banter_b4_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b4_level_start_tier2_1.text: Lock on to tachyon signatures, not optical scans. The clouds bend light.

banter_b4_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b4_level_start_tier2_2.text: Maintain tight formation. If you get separated in the Veil, you're toast.

banter_b4_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_level_start_tier3_0.text: We see through their illusions now. Target the true plasma cores.

banter_b4_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: naya
banter_b4_level_start_tier3_1.text: Full sensor synchronization. Cutting right through the nebula fog.

banter_b4_unique_enemy_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_unique_enemy_0.text: That enemy just changed shape. Reality is thin here.

banter_b4_unique_enemy_1.speaker: naya
banter_b4_unique_enemy_1.text: Quantum superposition drones. Shoot them before they collapse into armor state.

banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: A giant made of gas and thought. How do you fight a dream?

banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: It's not fighting us, Daddy... it's just trying to wake up!

banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Disperse the plasma vortices with spread fire before it creates a cyclone!

banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Target the anchor beacons on its perimeter! That's what holds its form!

banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Keep moving laterally! Its tachyon beam locks onto stationary vectors!

banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: We know the cyclone patterns. Break its anchors and free the sky!

banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b4_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: The dream is clearing, Daddy! Final burst!

banter_b4_player_death_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b4_player_death_1.text: Daddy! Stay in your ship! Don't let the nebula dissolve you!

banter_b4_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Focus. Anchor to reality. We're flying through.

banter_b4_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Tachyon filters engaged. Illusions won't trick us again.

banter_b4_player_respawn_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_player_respawn_tier3_0.text: Nothing stops this run. Let's finish the Veil.

banter_b4_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_low_health_0.text: Cockpit glass is refracting! I can't tell which way is forward!

banter_b4_wave_clear_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_wave_clear_0.text: Nebula sector clear. The stars are looking sharper.

banter_b4_level_end_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_level_end_0.text: The Dreamer showed me my own memories. It wasn't attacking.

banter_b4_level_end_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b4_level_end_1.text: It just wants someone to listen, Daddy.

banter_b4_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b4_pull_out_0.text: Reality is warping my hull geometry! My thrusters are firing backward! Pulling out!

banter_b4_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b4_pull_out_1.text: The Dreamer is whispering directly to me... the stars are too bright! I can't breathe!

banter_b4_pull_out_2.speaker: naya
banter_b4_pull_out_2.text: These shape-shifters are mimicking my sensor targets. I can't tell friend from foe. Backing off!

banter_b5_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b5_level_start_tier1_0.text: Saturn's rings. Beautiful from a distance. Up close, frozen shrapnel.

banter_b5_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: cross
banter_b5_level_start_tier1_1.text: Navy patrol frequency active. They're hunting us with heavy destroyers.

banter_b5_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b5_level_start_tier2_0.text: Navy strike wings use converging crossfires. Punch through the lead fighter early!

banter_b5_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: cross
banter_b5_level_start_tier2_1.text: I know their tactical playbook. They deploy railgun turrets behind the ice boulders.

banter_b5_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b5_level_start_tier2_2.text: Keep your shields angled forward. Don't get bracketed by their flak.

banter_b5_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b5_level_start_tier3_0.text: We outfly their best aces every time. Sweep the ring plane!

banter_b5_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: cross
banter_b5_level_start_tier3_1.text: Navy command has no answer for our maneuvers. Advance and dismantle.

banter_b5_unique_enemy_0.speaker: cross
banter_b5_unique_enemy_0.text: Umbra Squad stealth interceptors. They decloak right before firing.

banter_b5_unique_enemy_1.speaker: darius
banter_b5_unique_enemy_1.text: Watch for the radar ripple before they strike.

banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: cross
banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: The Kraken's the priority. My squad — I'll handle them.

banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: darius
banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: Massive Navy mobile fortress. It's deploying heavy torpedo bays.

banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: cross
banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Destroy the torpedo tubes first! That cuts their burst DPS in half.

banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: darius
banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Flank to the ventral blindspot when the dorsal cannons fire!

banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: naya
banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Targeting the hangar deck to prevent reinforcement waves!

banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: We've dissected this fortress. Tear out the main reactor core!

banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: cross
banter_b5_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: End of the line for Navy black-ops. Fire all batteries!

banter_b5_player_death_0.speaker: darius
banter_b5_player_death_0.text: Cross... finish the mission... protect Lyra...

banter_b5_player_death_1.speaker: cross
banter_b5_player_death_1.text: Darius! Stay with me! Pulling you out of the crossfire!

banter_b5_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b5_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Rebooting avionics. Navy hasn't won yet.

banter_b5_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b5_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Radar jammers tuned to Navy tactical band. Engaging.

banter_b5_player_respawn_tier2_1.speaker: cross
banter_b5_player_respawn_tier2_1.text: Formation reformed. Let's make them regret tracking us.

banter_b5_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b5_low_health_0.text: Railgun slug clipped the main engine! Losing thrust!

banter_b5_level_end_1.speaker: cross
banter_b5_level_end_1.text: Because I had a son too. And the Navy took him.

banter_b5_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b5_pull_out_0.text: Squadron Umbra has me locked with heavy torpedoes! Pulling out of the ring plane!

banter_b5_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b5_pull_out_1.text: The metal ships... they are so angry, they want to kill us. I'm dropping the sensor link!

banter_b5_pull_out_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b5_pull_out_2.text: Navy jammer has cut my fire control. Weapons are cold. I'm out of here!

banter_b6_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_level_start_tier1_0.text: Supernova remnant. Every surface is slag.

banter_b6_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: naya
banter_b6_level_start_tier1_1.text: Thermal radiation exceeding safety thresholds. Keep cooling cycle active.

banter_b6_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_level_start_tier2_0.text: Solar flares pulse every 15 seconds. Take cover behind the molten asteroids!

banter_b6_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b6_level_start_tier2_1.text: Plasma drones absorb heat from our lasers. Switch to kinetic missiles!

banter_b6_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b6_level_start_tier2_2.text: Watch the lava jets from the shattered crust. Fly high!

banter_b6_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_level_start_tier3_0.text: We know the solar flare timings by heart. Push through the furnace.

banter_b6_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: naya
banter_b6_level_start_tier3_1.text: All thermal shields calibrated. Maximum forward velocity.

banter_b6_unique_enemy_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_unique_enemy_0.text: Molten heavy juggernaut! Its armor is liquid titanium!

banter_b6_unique_enemy_1.speaker: naya
banter_b6_unique_enemy_1.text: Cool it with cryogenic burst or strike its exhaust port!

banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: The Forge-Mind. It's smelting precursor relics into combat automatons.

banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: naya
banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: Massive automated foundry. Heat levels off the chart.

banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Aim for the crucible coolers before it dumps molten slag across the arena!

banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Targeting conveyor tracks to stop the drone assembly line!

banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Stay clear of the central forge hammer! It causes structural shockwaves!

banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: Shut this forge down for good. Heavy ordnance on the master forge core!

banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: naya
banter_b6_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: Foundry overload initiated. Finish the strike!

banter_b6_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Coolant replenished. Diving back into the furnace.

banter_b6_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Thermal deflectors overclocked. Let's finish the Forge-Mind.

banter_b6_player_respawn_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b6_player_respawn_tier2_1.text: Heatsinks cleared. Ready for the next salvo.

banter_b6_player_respawn_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_player_respawn_tier3_0.text: Forged in fire. Nothing in this furnace can stop us.

banter_b6_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_low_health_0.text: Temperature alarm blaring! Hull plates are warping!

banter_b6_wave_clear_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_wave_clear_0.text: Forge automatons destroyed. The ash is settling.

banter_b6_level_end_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_level_end_0.text: Haven-7 was attacked. Lyra is changing. I need to get back.

banter_b6_level_end_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b6_level_end_1.text: Daddy, the thing in the dark isn't angry. It's scared.

banter_b6_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b6_pull_out_0.text: Thermal shield is melting! My cockpit is burning up! I'm pulling out!

banter_b6_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b6_pull_out_1.text: The fire... it's screaming. Haven-7 was attacked... Selene? Mom? I can't hear them!

banter_b6_pull_out_2.speaker: cross
banter_b6_pull_out_2.text: Forge-Mind plasma beam has melted my armor plating. Pulling back before my reactor blows!

banter_b7_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_level_start_tier1_0.text: Eternal hurricane. Five thousand mph winds. A mad god in the eye.

banter_b7_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: thorne
banter_b7_level_start_tier1_1.text: Jovian storm currents will tear any loose plating off your ship. Tighten up!

banter_b7_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_level_start_tier2_0.text: Ride the wind shears instead of fighting them! Drift with the cyclone current.

banter_b7_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b7_level_start_tier2_1.text: Lightning arcs between the cloud pylons. Destroy the pylons to ground the storm.

banter_b7_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b7_level_start_tier2_2.text: Thunderbirds dive from the upper eye wall. Keep radar pointed up!

banter_b7_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_level_start_tier3_0.text: We've mastered the storm flight paths. Cut straight through to the eye.

banter_b7_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: thorne
banter_b7_level_start_tier3_1.text: No storm on Jupiter can ground this squadron. Full burn!

banter_b7_unique_enemy_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_unique_enemy_0.text: Lightning ray! It's chaining high-voltage arcs across our fighters!

banter_b7_unique_enemy_1.speaker: naya
banter_b7_unique_enemy_1.text: Spread out to prevent conductive arc-chaining!

banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: The Storm-Singer. A giant atmospheric beast generating the cyclone.

banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: It's singing with the thunder... it's trying to drown out its own pain.

banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Shoot the electrical gills when it inhales the storm clouds!

banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Drop resonance disruptors into its lightning vortex to break the barrier!

banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Roll 90 degrees when it charges the hurricane funnel!

banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: Third clash in the eye. Put the Storm-Singer to rest!

banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: naya
banter_b7_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: Vortex collapsed. Firing the finishing torpedo spread!

banter_b7_player_death_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_player_death_0.text: Torn apart in the squall... Lyra...

banter_b7_player_death_1.speaker: thorne
banter_b7_player_death_1.text: Darius went down in the vortex! Deploying storm winch!

banter_b7_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Engines re-ignited in the eye. Let's finish the dive.

banter_b7_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Faraday cage active. Lightning won't short our thrusters now.

banter_b7_player_respawn_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b7_player_respawn_tier2_1.text: Atmospheric gyros steady. Back on vector.

banter_b7_player_respawn_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_player_respawn_tier3_0.text: Riding the lightning. We take the eye today.

banter_b7_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_low_health_0.text: Turbulence tearing off the stabilizer! Flight control failing!

banter_b7_wave_clear_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_wave_clear_0.text: Storm wave dispersed. Eye of the storm holding stable.

banter_b7_level_end_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_level_end_0.text: The Storm-Singer chose death over madness.

banter_b7_level_end_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b7_level_end_1.text: Its song is peaceful now, Daddy. It's resting.

banter_b7_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b7_pull_out_0.text: The atmospheric pressure is crushing my hull! Winds are tearing my wings off! Pulling out!

banter_b7_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b7_pull_out_1.text: The lightning... it's singing. It's so loud it hurts my head! I have to go!

banter_b7_pull_out_2.speaker: naya
banter_b7_pull_out_2.text: Megastorm lightning has shorted my primary battery! I'm dead in the air, pulling back!

banter_b8_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_level_start_tier1_0.text: The ghost fleet. Hundreds of Navy ships, abandoned.

banter_b8_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: cross
banter_b8_level_start_tier1_1.text: Admiral Crane's automated defense network is still guarding the wrecks.

banter_b8_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_level_start_tier2_0.text: Automated point-defense turrets are networked. Take out the radar carrier first!

banter_b8_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: cross
banter_b8_level_start_tier2_1.text: Crane's AI uses flanking ambush pods hidden in the hollow hulls. Watch your flank.

banter_b8_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b8_level_start_tier2_2.text: Beware proximity mines tethered to the wreckage corridors.

banter_b8_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_level_start_tier3_0.text: We know Crane's automated subroutines. Dismantle the fleet.

banter_b8_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: cross
banter_b8_level_start_tier3_1.text: Severing their tactical data links. The ghost fleet is ours.

banter_b8_unique_enemy_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_unique_enemy_0.text: Heavy automated dreadnought! It's charging bow rail cannons!

banter_b8_unique_enemy_1.speaker: cross
banter_b8_unique_enemy_1.text: Stay in its dorsal blindspot! Those bow cannons can't elevate!

banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: Admiral Crane's flagship: the Goliath. Controlled by his digital ghost.

banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: cross
banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: Crane... you enslaved whole generations for this machine. It ends here.

banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Focus on the automated shield relay ships escorting the Goliath!

banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: cross
banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Override codes applied to the port missile batteries. Strike the breach!

banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Dive under the broadside salvo! It fires in 3-second staggered volleys!

banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: No more ghosts. Time to bury Crane's flagship in the scrap pile.

banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: cross
banter_b8_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: Primary reactor breached. Firing the final salute.

banter_b8_player_death_1.speaker: cross
banter_b8_player_death_1.text: Darius is down! Suppressive fire, protect the lead ship!

banter_b8_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Rebooted. Ghost fleet hasn't buried us yet.

banter_b8_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Counter-hack installed. Crane can't scramble our HUD.

banter_b8_player_respawn_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_player_respawn_tier3_0.text: Iron will. The fleet falls today.

banter_b8_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_low_health_0.text: Armor plating sheared by railgun fire! Critical warning!

banter_b8_wave_clear_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_wave_clear_0.text: Ghost fleet vanguard neutralized. Path to the flagship open.

banter_b8_level_end_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_level_end_0.text: My family was engineered. Three generations. But Lyra is NOT a weapon.

banter_b8_level_end_1.speaker: cross
banter_b8_level_end_1.text: None of us are weapons, Darius. We are free.

banter_b8_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b8_pull_out_0.text: The automated Navy dreadnought has me pinned with heavy lasers! I'm pulling out!

banter_b8_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b8_pull_out_1.text: Admiral Crane's voice... it's inside my head. He's saying we are all just weapons... I want to leave!

banter_b8_pull_out_2.speaker: naya
banter_b8_pull_out_2.text: Defense lasers have sliced through my starboard engine! I'm pulling back to the wreckage!

banter_b9_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_level_start_tier1_0.text: The first world the Dreamer transformed. Nothing here is real.

banter_b9_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b9_level_start_tier1_1.text: The Hive is whispering in thousands of voices... they want to make us sleep.

banter_b9_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_level_start_tier2_0.text: Neural spores are distorting our flight vectors. Keep your eyes on the physical compass!

banter_b9_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b9_level_start_tier2_1.text: Bio-luminescent tendrils regenerate if not severed completely. Use rapid fire.

banter_b9_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b9_level_start_tier2_2.text: Daddy, I'm maintaining a psychic shield around your cockpit. Trust my voice.

banter_b9_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_level_start_tier3_0.text: We know the Hive's neural tricks. Push straight through the synaptic matrix.

banter_b9_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: naya
banter_b9_level_start_tier3_1.text: Synaptic resonance steady. Piercing their collective barrier.

banter_b9_unique_enemy_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_unique_enemy_0.text: Synaptic parasite drone! It's latching onto the shield matrix!

banter_b9_unique_enemy_1.speaker: naya
banter_b9_unique_enemy_1.text: Roll maneuver and pulse shields to shake it off!

banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: The Hive Mother. A cosmic nexus of stolen minds and biomass.

banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: She's holding so many stolen souls... we have to wake them up!

banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Sever the neural tentacles before she channels the psychic scream!

banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Focus heavy fire on the bio-plasma sacs at her base!

banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: thorne
banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Clear the spore swarm immediately or they'll detonate on your canopy!

banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: We know every tendril swipe. Break the Hive Mother's crown!

banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b9_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: Her song is breaking, Daddy! Free the stolen minds!

banter_b9_player_death_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_player_death_0.text: The song is so sweet... no... Lyra...

banter_b9_player_death_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b9_player_death_1.text: Daddy! Wake up! Don't let the Hive take you!

banter_b9_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Mind clear. Neural link secured. We finish this.

banter_b9_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Psychic feedback filters at 100%. The Hive won't cloud our aim.

banter_b9_player_respawn_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b9_player_respawn_tier2_1.text: Bio-matrix purged. Advancing into the core.

banter_b9_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_low_health_0.text: Neural link fracturing! My hands are going numb!

banter_b9_wave_clear_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_wave_clear_0.text: Hive node shattered. Synaptic distortion dropping.

banter_b9_level_end_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_level_end_0.text: The Hive offered me everything. I almost said yes.

banter_b9_level_end_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b9_level_end_1.text: You said no because you love us, Daddy. That's real.

banter_b9_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b9_pull_out_0.text: The Hive is showing me Lyra... but it's not her. It's trying to dissolve my mind! Pulling out!

banter_b9_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b9_pull_out_1.text: The Hive wants to take my memories... they want to keep my childhood. I won't let them!

banter_b9_pull_out_2.speaker: naya
banter_b9_pull_out_2.text: These false realities are trying to convince me this is Haven-7. I'm pulling back before I lose myself!

banter_b10_level_start_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_level_start_tier1_0.text: Edge of a black hole. The last Coelacanth. This is it.

banter_b10_level_start_tier1_1.speaker: architect
banter_b10_level_start_tier1_1.text: The void awaits... why do you bring light into the final rest...

banter_b10_level_start_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_level_start_tier2_0.text: Event horizon gravitational shearing is intense! Counter-steer away from the vortex!

banter_b10_level_start_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b10_level_start_tier2_1.text: Chrono-anomalies ahead! Enemies repeat their attack loops—anticipate the rewind!

banter_b10_level_start_tier2_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b10_level_start_tier2_2.text: The Architect's fear is warping spacetime. Hold the center vector, Daddy!

banter_b10_level_start_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_level_start_tier3_0.text: We know the chrono-warp cycles. Time to answer the Architect and end the loop.

banter_b10_level_start_tier3_1.speaker: naya
banter_b10_level_start_tier3_1.text: All systems at peak synchronization. For Lyra. For everyone.

banter_b10_unique_enemy_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_unique_enemy_0.text: Chrono-sentinel! It's teleporting across temporal rifts!

banter_b10_unique_enemy_1.speaker: naya
banter_b10_unique_enemy_1.text: Lead your target into its arrival coordinates!

banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier1_0.text: That's no reality. That's its nightmares. I have to show it — it's not alone.

banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier1_1.speaker: architect
banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier1_1.text: We were the first... we will be the last... burn with us in the eternal silence!

banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier2_0.text: Destroy the Singularity Launchers before it warps the event horizon!

banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier2_1.text: Dorsal Chrono Railgun charging! Dive under the beam arc!

banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier2_2.speaker: lyra
banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier2_2.text: Daddy, the Unbound Chrono Core is vulnerable when it rewinds! Strike then!

banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier3_0.text: This is the final test. No more loops. Deliver the answer!

banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier3_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier3_1.text: I'm with you, Daddy! All the way through the light!

banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier3_2.speaker: naya
banter_b10_boss_entrance_tier3_2.text: Full fleet salvo! Break the singularity!

banter_b10_player_death_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_player_death_0.text: The void is swallowing everything... Lyra... hold my hand...

banter_b10_player_death_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b10_player_death_1.text: Daddy! I'm here! I won't let go!

banter_b10_player_respawn_tier1_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_player_respawn_tier1_0.text: Rebooting at the rift threshold. We are not letting the universe die in fear.

banter_b10_player_respawn_tier2_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_player_respawn_tier2_0.text: Chrono-stabilizers locked. Spacetime won't shatter our resolve.

banter_b10_player_respawn_tier2_1.speaker: naya
banter_b10_player_respawn_tier2_1.text: Singularity shields holding. Back to the event horizon.

banter_b10_player_respawn_tier3_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_player_respawn_tier3_0.text: Final push into eternity. Let's finish the Cyber Coelacanth.

banter_b10_low_health_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_low_health_0.text: Singularity shear tearing through the hull! Hull integrity 10%!

banter_b10_wave_clear_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_wave_clear_0.text: Chrono rift sealed. Final approach to the Architect's Core.

banter_b10_level_end_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_level_end_0.text: I'm not here to defeat it. I'm here to answer it.

banter_b10_level_end_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b10_level_end_1.text: We answered it together, Daddy. We're going home.

banter_b10_pull_out_0.speaker: darius
banter_b10_pull_out_0.text: The black hole's gravity is pulling me past the event horizon! I'm pushing engines to the limit, pulling out!

banter_b10_pull_out_1.speaker: lyra
banter_b10_pull_out_1.text: The Architect's nightmare is too loud... it's the end of everything! I can't look!

banter_b10_pull_out_2.speaker: naya
banter_b10_pull_out_2.text: Gravitational shearing is tearing my hull apart! I have to back off before I'm crushed!

ending_sacrifice_lyra_final.speaker: lyra
ending_sacrifice_lyra_final.text: It's okay, Daddy. I know what I have to do. My signal will neutralize the singularity from within.

ending_sacrifice_darius_farewell.speaker: darius
ending_sacrifice_darius_farewell.text: One life exchanged for a galaxy. For you, Lyra... the stars will always shine.

ending_transcendence_lyra_unbound.speaker: lyra
ending_transcendence_lyra_unbound.text: We are not ending, Daddy. We are becoming something else. We dreamed ourselves into gods.

ending_transcendence_darius_unbound.speaker: darius
ending_transcendence_darius_unbound.text: Beyond the physical realm... the Nyxa and humanity evolve beyond the reach of war.

ending_dominion_darius_supreme.speaker: darius
ending_dominion_darius_supreme.text: The Coelacanth network is mine. Absolute power belongs to humanity now.

ending_dominion_thorne_warning.speaker: thorne
ending_dominion_thorne_warning.text: Absolute power has a cost, Darius. And the galaxy will soon learn what that cost is.

avionics_hull_critical.speaker: selene
avionics_hull_critical.text: Warning: Hull integrity critical. Shield collapse imminent.

avionics_quantum_ready.speaker: selene
avionics_quantum_ready.text: Precursor Quantum Fabricator operational. Scrap magnetism active.

avionics_singularity_warning.speaker: selene
avionics_singularity_warning.text: Proximity alert: Precursor Singularity anomaly detected.

avionics_wingman_link_ok.speaker: selene
avionics_wingman_link_ok.text: Tactical squadron data link established. All wingmen synced.

log_b1_l1.speaker: darius
log_b1_l1.text: Marcus Star Log #01: We breached the Mariana crust at 11,000 meters. The sonar echoes aren't bouncing off rock—something is absorbing sound.

log_b1_l2.speaker: selene
log_b1_l2.text: Haven-7 Survey: Coral polyp clusters here generate coherent laser frequencies when stimulated by intruders.

log_b1_l3.speaker: selene
log_b1_l3.text: Scrap Recovery Memo: This exploration frigate went dark in 2048. Its hull plating is fused with living coelacanth scales.

log_b1_l4.speaker: darius
log_b1_l4.text: Marcus Star Log #04: The chasm pulled our bathysphere downward at 30 knots. Natural currents don't move like this.

log_b1_l5.speaker: thorne
log_b1_l5.text: Navy Surveillance Intercept: Precursor beacon transmitting 4.8 THz quantum carrier wave toward Jupiter.

log_b1_l6.speaker: selene
log_b1_l6.text: Haven-7 Xenology: Aqueducts carved from monomolecular carbon. They carried biosynthetic amniotic fluids.

log_b1_l7.speaker: selene
log_b1_l7.text: Medical Log: Kelp fronds release microscopic spores that induce hallucinations and temporal disorientation.

log_b1_l8.speaker: selene
log_b1_l8.text: Thermal Analysis: Vent chimneys discharging 450°C mineral slurry. Thermal shield integrity mandatory.

log_b1_l9.speaker: thorne
log_b1_l9.text: Tactical Recon: Titanium fortress gates armed with magnetic rail cannons. Break through the perimeter.

log_b1_l10.speaker: selene
log_b1_l10.text: Classified Core File: The Abyssal Guardian Coelacanth has protected this trench for ten millennia. It will not yield.

log_b2_l1.speaker: selene
log_b2_l1.text: Haven-7 Archive: The Great Dying bleached this colony in a single hour. Nothing living was spared.

log_b2_l2.speaker: selene
log_b2_l2.text: Xenobiology: The ribcage belongs to an organism larger than any dreadnought in the Terran fleet.

log_b2_l3.speaker: thorne
log_b2_l3.text: Navy Casualty Record: 3rd Heavy Flotilla lost during the first contact skirmish. Their automated guns still fire.

log_b2_l4.speaker: selene
log_b2_l4.text: Haven-7 Bio-Hazmat: Neurotoxins attack synaptic neural links, causing control lag in pilot rigs.

log_b2_l5.speaker: darius
log_b2_l5.text: Dr. Marcus Star Log #12: When the crystals vibrate, they project auditory memories of people you love.

log_b2_l6.speaker: architect
log_b2_l6.text: Precursor Cipher: This arena tested warrior ships in ritual combat before the Fall.

log_b2_l7.speaker: selene
log_b2_l7.text: Sensor Report: Light bouncing through these diamond pillars can blind target acquisition sensors.

log_b2_l8.speaker: selene
log_b2_l8.text: Salvage Memo: Billions of bio-synthetic components buried in the silt bed. High scrap concentration.

log_b2_l9.speaker: selene
log_b2_l9.text: Haven-7 Tactical: The inner sanctum is shielded by a holographic matrix powered by Precursor souls.

log_b2_l10.speaker: architect
log_b2_l10.text: Final Precursor Log: The Vault Golem was built from our collective grief. Strike its heart to set it free.

log_b3_l1.speaker: selene
log_b3_l1.text: Europa Exploration File: Water temperature under the ice sheet sits at -4°C with heavy salt saturation.

log_b3_l2.speaker: selene
log_b3_l2.text: Haven-7 Geological: Geysers erupt every 8 seconds, launching ice shrapnel at supersonic speeds.

log_b3_l3.speaker: cross
log_b3_l3.text: Ophion Design Note: The prototype embryos lack cognitive dampers. They attack anything that generates heat.

log_b3_l4.speaker: selene
log_b3_l4.text: Thermal Scan: Deep geothermal fractures provide the only warmth in this frozen grave.

log_b3_l5.speaker: selene
log_b3_l5.text: Automated Defense Log: High-voltage cables connect the hatchery pylons. Sever them to advance.

log_b3_l6.speaker: selene
log_b3_l6.text: Structural Warning: Overhead ice shelves are cracking under sonic vibrations from our weapons.

log_b3_l7.speaker: cross
log_b3_l7.text: Ophion Personal Log: Thousands of failed models were dumped here. I was the only one that achieved balance.

log_b3_l8.speaker: thorne
log_b3_l8.text: Terran Intelligence: Navy tried to weaponize these stasis pods. The automated defenses turned on them.

log_b3_l9.speaker: architect
log_b3_l9.text: Precursor Nursery Codex: Only those carrying the spark of ancient kinship may enter the Queen's chamber.

log_b3_l10.speaker: selene
log_b3_l10.text: Haven-7 Bio-Registry: The Hatchery Queen generates absolute zero fields that instantly shatter steel.

log_b4_l1.speaker: selene
log_b4_l1.text: Nebula Science Report: The Veil Nebula bends local spacetime, creating non-Euclidean flight corridors.

log_b4_l2.speaker: selene
log_b4_l2.text: Pilot Advisory: Target blips on radar may represent past or future positions of hostile craft.

log_b4_l3.speaker: selene
log_b4_l3.text: Astrophysics File: Heavy metal dust clouds strip shields if flown through at maximum velocity.

log_b4_l4.speaker: darius
log_b4_l4.text: Dr. Marcus Star Log #25: In the Veil, the ship's computers started generating poetry instead of math.

log_b4_l5.speaker: selene
log_b4_l5.text: Thermal Warning: Ionized gas cyclones reach speeds exceeding Mach 12.

log_b4_l6.speaker: selene
log_b4_l6.text: Haven-7 Astrometry: Baby stars igniting inside the dust pillars create spontaneous radiation surges.

log_b4_l7.speaker: selene
log_b4_l7.text: Quantum Field Note: Radio transmissions here arrive 10 seconds before they are transmitted.

log_b4_l8.speaker: thorne
log_b4_l8.text: Navy Search & Rescue: 12 destroyers vanished into the Veil in 2074. Their quantum silhouettes remain.

log_b4_l9.speaker: selene
log_b4_l9.text: Haven-7 Telemetry: The Dreamer's consciousness converges into a singular point of light.

log_b4_l10.speaker: architect
log_b4_l10.text: Classified Precursor Record: The Dreamer cannot be killed, only awakened. Shatter its cosmic anchors.

log_b5_l1.speaker: selene
log_b5_l1.text: Ring Navigation Guide: Saturn's B-ring consists of pure water ice chunks traveling at 15 km/s.

log_b5_l2.speaker: thorne
log_b5_l2.text: Navy Tactical Directive: Umbra Squad interceptors use active radar absorbing carbon metamaterials.

log_b5_l3.speaker: thorne
log_b5_l3.text: Navy Recon: Automated defense satellites stationed every 50 kilometers along the ring plane.

log_b5_l4.speaker: selene
log_b5_l4.text: Haven-7 Geology: Sub-surface geysers on ice boulders venting liquid nitrogen plumes.

log_b5_l5.speaker: selene
log_b5_l5.text: Sensor Advisory: Microscopic diamond crystals interfere with laser weapons, reducing beam coherence.

log_b5_l6.speaker: selene
log_b5_l6.text: Salvage Registry: Wreckage from the Second Interplanetary War trapped in orbital resonance.

log_b5_l7.speaker: thorne
log_b5_l7.text: Comms Log: Navy command broadcasting broadband white noise across all standard frequencies.

log_b5_l8.speaker: selene
log_b5_l8.text: Cryo Physics: Shadowed side of ring boulders reaches 2.7 Kelvin, causing superconductive hull stress.

log_b5_l9.speaker: thorne
log_b5_l9.text: Navy Combat Log: The Kraken Mobile Fortress is the flagship of EDC ring suppression forces.

log_b5_l10.speaker: thorne
log_b5_l10.text: Navy Black-Ops File: Destroying the Kraken will break EDC's blockade of the outer solar system.

log_b6_l1.speaker: selene
log_b6_l1.text: Haven-7 Sensor Sweep: Surface temperatures on asteroid fragments exceed 1200°C.

log_b6_l2.speaker: selene
log_b6_l2.text: Volcanic Advisory: Subterranean lava reservoirs bursting into the vacuum of space.

log_b6_l3.speaker: selene
log_b6_l3.text: Forge-Mind Automation: Automated smelting drones convert space wreckage into combat hulls.

log_b6_l4.speaker: selene
log_b6_l4.text: Stellar Warning: Coronal mass ejections from the dying star sweep the sector every 20 seconds.

log_b6_l5.speaker: selene
log_b6_l5.text: Haven-7 Survey: Razor-sharp volcanic glass formations lining the interior canyons.

log_b6_l6.speaker: selene
log_b6_l6.text: Forge Architecture: Giant magnetic containment vats holding thousands of tons of liquid titanium.

log_b6_l7.speaker: selene
